caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane mounted on a vertical rod. At the top of the rod sits a greenish-bronze rooster standing on a spherical base. Beneath this, an arrow points to the right, with one end shaped as a feathered tail and the other as a pointed tip, both in a bronze or brown color. Below the arrow, the cardinal direction indicators “N,” “S,” “E,” and “W” are arranged around the central rod and are rendered in green, with decorative scrollwork connecting them. Lower down the rod, another metallic sphere is present, matching the color and texture of the upper sphere. The composition is vertically oriented, with each element stacked above the other, and the colors used include muted greens and browns. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset showing a simplified outline of the weather vane’s side profile. The background is plain, off-white paper, and the drawing is framed with a simple rectangular border.
title: Weather Vane
